_comment: Shared phone-matcher fixtures (docs/OPEN.md queue #1, 2026-09-14). Read by src/lib/contactFilterParity.test.ts (client scanMessage AND the pattern literal in the newest migration defining contact_leak_reason) and by scripts/probes/contact-scan-phone.probe.mjs (the real Postgres function). A phone is 10 digits, or 11 starting with 1 (+1), with 0-4 separator characters between groups, and never a window inside a longer digit run. Exception (lh-trust-safety review 2026-09-14): when BOTH gaps between the 3-3-4 groups are real separators, a digit glued on the front or back does not hide it ('0225 555 0199', '225-555-01990'); a bare run of digits keeps the boundary rule ('22555501992255550199' is not a phone).
